name: noisy-estimate
title: One number, two parts
idea: A reported estimate is its true value plus noise, and the noise changes each time the data are collected again.
credit: Built for this site; estimate-plus-noise model after Walters, Mixtape slides pp. 5–6; Kline, Rose and Walters (2024), Section III, Assumption 1 (stated before Section III.A), and talk slide 17; and the postrank theory book, ch. 2, “Teacher growth categories: evidence, precision, and the choice of assessment”.
caption: Simulated estimates: each is the true value plus the SE times a random draw from the bell-shaped normal curve, and the seed fixes the draws.
